community_platform_notes.amd_integrated_gpus_linux: AMD APU integrated GPUs (e.g. Ryzen 7840U/8840U Radeon 780M sharing system DDR5 via GTT) can serve the CPU/iGPU Granite-1B Q4_K_M tier, but are excluded from default QLoRA training unless UMA carveout >= 8 GiB is pinned in BIOS and ROCm hipBLAS supports the gfx1103 target.
community_platform_notes.windows_wddm_headroom: Windows 10/11 WDDM reserves 700-1,100 MiB of dedicated VRAM for desktop compositing (DWM) and browser hardware acceleration. On an 8 GiB card (8,192 MiB), only ~7,100 MiB is available before paging to shared system memory; keeping vram_peak_mib <= 3,716 MiB under the 4,300 MiB floor prevents WDDM shared-PCIe thrashing.
